name: Inline Text / Read-Only Bound Value
description: Inline text node. Used for three distinct jobs in this codebase: section heading text, grid header cell captions, and read-only bound values inside grid rows. Critically different from atom.label (lbl): a span carries its text in `chld`, while lbl carries it in `props.text`. Both exist; they are not interchangeable, and the choice is positional — headings and grid cells use span, field labels use lbl.
sourceRefs: examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md 1.3 (section headings), 3.2 (grid header cells), 3.5 (PURDET_DOCSRNO, PURDET_STOCK_DESC, PURDET_UNIT_DOCNO), PART 5.1 (ADAMTDET_MST_DOCNO, ADAMTDET_MST_DESC)

style.description: Frequently an empty object {} even when nothing is styled — carried for consistency, harmless.

chld.description: Either a literal string or a bracket expression. In a list row template use the row context: "[this.FIELD_NAME]".

literal.description: Static caption — section headings and grid column headers.

gridHeaderCell.description: Grid header cells omit props entirely.

boundRowValue.description: Read-only value inside a list row template. Preferred over a disabled input for non-numeric display-only columns; for numbers use atom.numeric-label (dxnumlbl) instead.

usageNote: A span bound to [this.FIELD] is the cheapest read-only grid cell — no control instance, no dset/bind/rowindex props needed, because the list row context already supplies the value. Reach for it before reaching for a disabled control.
